title: Replacing PUCT with a Planning Model
summary: This thesis proposes replacing upper confidence bounds applied to trees (PUCT) with a learned planning model for action selection in Monte Carlo tree search. The authors train a base model using AlphaZero on Connect4, initialize a planning model through imitation learning, and investigate optimization using proximal policy optimization to improve agent performance.
